issues.issue: Whether the identity of the male minor claimants is established
issues.applicant_position: Says the minors' identities are as stated in the BOC; the discrepancies came from a consultant's errors.
issues.respondent_position: Minister says the principal claimant gave different names and birth dates for the male minors.
issues.result_quote: their identity has not been established

issues.issue: Whether the identity of the principal claimant and the female minors is established
issues.applicant_position: Says the passports establish the identities of the principal claimant and the female minors.
issues.result_quote: the panel will give those claimants the benefit of the doubt and accept the passports as sufficient to establish their identities and nationality

issues.issue: Whether the state involvement and threats in the narrative are credible
issues.applicant_position: Says state agents (Rangers) threatened the family after their public inquiries into the brother-in-law's death.
issues.result_quote: the addition of threats to the claimants and the involvement of state authorities in the narrative was likely an embellishment

issues.issue: Whether the family's public inquiries about the brother-in-law's death, and the threats, are credible
issues.applicant_position: Says the brother-in-law was killed by the state and the family's public inquiries led to threats.
issues.result_quote: the allegation of her family's public inquiries and resulting threats is not credible

issues.issue: Whether the claimants face a section 96 or 97 risk in Pakistan
issues.applicant_position: Claims a risk from state agents in Pakistan if returned.
issues.result_quote: The credibility findings undermine any claims under s. 96 or s. 97(1) of the IRPA
